philosophy: Editorial-grade reading experience. Strip decorative borders, let whitespace carry hierarchy, and reserve the accent blue for a single focal element per screen. Typography (not chrome) defines the design. Think Stripe Press + Medium, transposed into the SleepForecast dark palette.

ArticleIndex.layout: Single-column editorial. Hero header with generous vertical rhythm (pt-16 pb-10), then an unbordered divided list where each article is separated only by a thin hairline (border-t border-white/5) instead of individual cards. No card backgrounds, no hover fills — only text color shift and a subtle arrow translate on hover.

keyDecisions: Remove per-item card borders/backgrounds — replace with divide-y hairlines for a newspaper/magazine feel
Drop the BookOpen icon in the header — text-only eyebrow is cleaner and faster to scan
Tighten tracking on h1 (tracking-tight) and widen uppercase eyebrow letter-spacing to [0.18em] for editorial contrast
Disclaimer: drop the card chrome, use a simple top border instead (still readable, no font-size reduction)
Increase container top padding (pt-16/20) to give the index a calm 'landing' feel
Each row has min-h-[44px] + py-8 to guarantee mobile tap target compliance

ArticleDetail.layout: Narrow editorial column (max-w-[680px]) with breathing room. Back link sits above the fold as a quiet muted link. Header uses a large tracking-tight title, removes the bottom border (replaced by spacing), and isolates meta into a single horizontal muted row. JSON-LD script remains untouched.

keyDecisions: Replace border-b header separator with whitespace (mb-12) — lets the title breathe
Prose upgrade: use prose-lg, tighter heading tracking, leading-[1.85] body, remove h2 left-border accent in favor of pure typographic weight
Links: underline via border-b (softer than native text-decoration), thicken on hover
Blockquotes: thin 2px left accent (not 4px), muted text — subtle not shouty
CTA card: drop the gradient + colored border + rounded-2xl — replace with a flat top-border section. Only the Button itself carries the accent color, keeping ONE focal blue per screen
Related articles: convert from 2-col grid of cards into a divided list (matches index page pattern — system consistency)
Disclaimer: match index page — top-border only, no card chrome
Back link / button / row targets all hit min-h-[44px] for mobile

ArticleLayout.role: Reusable editorial frame. No visual chrome on the wrapper itself — all styling lives inside the sections (header / prose / cta / related / disclaimer). Consumes ArticleDetail tailwind classes above.
structuralNotes: Keep component API unchanged: (article, related) props
Keep JSON-LD injection untouched (lives in the page, not here)
Container swaps max-w-screen-md → max-w-[680px] for a tighter reading measure (~66ch)
Add a subtle fade-in on mount via Tailwind: animate-in fade-in duration-500 on the root article element

tokens.spacing: Rhythm on a 4px grid. Section gaps: mt-12 / mt-16 (between semantic blocks). Paragraph leading: 1.85. Container top padding: pt-14/16/20 (generous landing).
tokens.radius: Minimal. Buttons keep shadcn default. Tag pills: rounded-full. Code inline: rounded. NO rounded-2xl cards anywhere in F005.
tokens.typography: Hierarchy via size + weight + tracking, not color or borders. Scale: eyebrow 11px uppercase tracking-[0.18em], h1 28-34px tracking-tight, lede 16-17px, body 15.5px leading-[1.85], meta 12px, disclaimer 12px. Font weights: 400 body / 500 meta / 600 titles / 700 h1.
tokens.color: Single accent (#1d9bf0) used ONCE per screen as a focal point (the CTA button on detail, the hover state on index). Muted text always #8b92a5. No gradients. No colored backgrounds.
tokens.motion: Duration 200ms for color transitions, 500ms fade-in on mount. No scale/translate beyond 2px. No bounces.

accessibility: Contrast: #e6e8ee on #0f1117 = 14.8:1 (AAA). #8b92a5 on #0f1117 = 5.9:1 (AA normal text passes). #1d9bf0 on #0f1117 = 6.4:1 (AA).
Tap targets: back link, article rows, related rows, CTA button all enforce min-h-[44px]
Reading measure: max-w-[680px] keeps line length at ~66ch for optimal readability
Underlines restored on body links (border-b) so links are distinguishable without relying on color alone
prose-li leading-[1.8] avoids cramped lists for users with dyslexia / low vision
Eyebrow labels use uppercase + letter-spacing — still readable (text-[11px] with tracking gives comfortable x-height)
Medical disclaimer font size unchanged (text-[12px]) per harness rule
Respects prefers-reduced-motion via Tailwind's built-in motion-safe handling on animate-in (Generator to add motion-reduce:animate-none if needed)
Back link has a visible focus-visible ring via shadcn defaults (Generator to ensure focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#1d9bf0]/50 rounded-sm on link)
All interactive elements keep text color change on hover (not border-only) so color-blind users perceive the affordance

rationale.whyLessChrome: The current WIP wraps every list item and CTA in a card with border + background. That creates visual noise on a long-form reading surface. Editorial design (NYT, The Verge, Stripe Press) strips chrome so the reader focuses on type. We follow that convention.
rationale.whyOneAccent: SleepForecast's brand accent #1d9bf0 is most impactful when rare. Using it on every eyebrow + every hover + every card border + the CTA gradient dilutes it. Reserving it for ONE focal per screen (the CTA button) makes the CTA feel urgent without shouting.
rationale.whyNarrowerColumn: max-w-screen-md (768px) is too wide for ~16px body text — lines run ~85-90 characters, hurting comprehension. max-w-[680px] lands on the research-backed 60-75 character sweet spot.
rationale.whyDivideY: divide-y hairlines (border-white/5) visually group the list without boxing each item. This also improves scan-ability: the eye flows vertically without stopping at card edges.
